adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the `:category` option entirely (`lib/tasks/disqus.thor` deletes `method_option :category`) and stops passing both `created_at` and `category` into `PostCreator` (old code built `PostCreator.new(..., created_at: ..., category: category_id)`). It now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and `TopicEmbed.import_remote`/`.import` have no handling for category or created_at, so imported topics will no longer preserve category selection or original timestamps. Also, `TopicEmbed.import` returns early unless `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, so threads with non-http(s) `t[:link]` will result in `post` being nil and the thread effectively skipped (the thor task only continues when `post.present?`). Finally, `import_remote` does a live `open(url).read` per thread, increasing network dependency/cost compared to the previous permalink-only topic creation.
